notes.title: 🎮 BitSummit the 13th Exhibition Announcement 🎮
notes.content:
[h2]Joining BitSummit! First-ever Kansai Exhibition![/h2][p]We are excited to announce our participation in [b]BitSummit the 13th "Summer of Yokai"[/b]!
This marks the [b]first-ever exhibition of "Menhera-rium" in the Kansai region[/b]![/p][hr][/hr][h2]📅 Event Overview[/h2][p][b]Event Dates[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]July 18, 2025 (Friday)[/b] - Business Day (Industry professionals only)[/p][/*][*][p][b]July 19-20, 2025 (Saturday & Sunday)[/b] - Public Days (Open to the public)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Event Hours[/b]
10:00 AM - 5:00 PM[/p][p][b]Venue[/b]
Kyoto Municipal Industrial Promotion Hall "Miyako Messe"
9-1 Okazaki Seishoji-cho, Sakyo-ku, Kyoto 606-8343, Japan[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 Exhibition Content[/h2][h3]🎮 Menhera-rium[/h3][p][b]Latest Version[/b] debuts in Kansai for the first time![/p][p]"Menhera-rium," which has been well-received at events in the Kanto region, is finally making its Kansai debut!
At BitSummit the 13th, you'll be able to play the [b]latest version[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h2]📍 Booth Information[/h2][p][b]Booth Number: 3F-D58[/b][/p][p]Please come visit us![/p][hr][/hr][h2]📍 Access Information[/h2][p][b]By Train[/b][/p][list][*][p]Subway Tozai Line "Higashiyama Station" - 8-minute walk[/p][/*][*][p]Keihan Main Line "Sanjo Station" - 15-minute walk[/p][/*][*][p]City Bus "Okazaki Park Museum/Heian Shrine" - Right at the stop[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Kansai visitors, thank you for waiting![/b]
The time has finally come for you to experience "Menhera-rium" in the Kansai region.
This is a rare opportunity to get hands-on experience with the latest version![/p][p]Additionally, BitSummit the 13th features numerous carefully selected indie games from Japan and around the world, beyond just "Menhera-rium." You'll discover games across various genres with unique personalities, enjoy interactions between developers, and participate in special yokai-themed events.[/p][p]Please take this opportunity to enjoy "BitSummit," which is full of indie game charm![/p]
